text: DSH Obsidian Bridge（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把 DSH 与本机 Obsidian Vault 连接起来，通过 Cordis 注册笔记搜索、笔记读取、草稿写入和会话链接工具，并可选择在模型步骤前注入相关笔记或把其他工具结果保存为草稿。搜索使用 SQLite FTS5 索引，支持按笔记标题和内容查找；读取工具可按文件路径或 wiki-link 名称获取正文与 frontmatter。适合希望在 DSH 对话中检索个人知识库、保存分析草稿并关联工作会话的用户。需要配置 Vault 路径；不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Obsidian Bridge connects DSH to a local vault. Tools search and read notes, save drafts, and link notes to sessions. SQLite FTS5 indexes titles and content; optional hooks add notes before model steps or capture tool results. Configure the vault path; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 能搜索我的 Obsidian 笔记并找到相关内容
怎样在 DSH 对话里读取指定的 Vault 笔记？
I want to save an agent summary as a draft note in my Obsidian vault.
DSH Obsidian Bridge 的功能「Vault 笔记搜索」：通过 obsidian_search 按查询词检索 Vault 笔记标题和内容，返回匹配路径、标题、摘要片段及相关度分数；limit 可限制结果数，默认 10 条。
DSH Obsidian Bridge 的功能「笔记读取与草稿」：可按路径或 wiki-link 读取笔记正文与 frontmatter，也可把标题、Markdown 内容和标签保存为 Vault 草稿。

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · dsh-obsidian-bridge：Bidirectional knowledge bridge between [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) and [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md) Vault.

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · What It Does：Gives DSH agents direct read/write access to your Obsidian Vault. The agent can search notes via SQLite FTS5 full-text search, read full content by path or wiki-link, write draft notes back to the vault, and create bidirectional links between DSH sessions and notes.

Unlike existing one-way export tools or MCP-based bridges, this plugin runs natively inside the DSH Cordis framework — no external server, no need for Obsidian to be running.

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Architecture：```
DSH Agent (Node.js process)
  └─ Cordis Framework
       └─ dsh-obsidian-bridge plugin (apply(ctx, config))
            ├─ Config Schema (zod: vaultPath, autoContext, autoCapture, draftFolder, sessionId)

Single process. No external server. Direct file system access.

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Prerequisites：- Node.js >= 22.19 (or >= 24)
- DSH installed: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- An Obsidian Vault directory

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Build：```bash
cd dsh-obsidian-bridge
npm install
npm run build
```

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Install into DSH：**Option A: From GitHub (recommended — no npm account needed)**

```bash
dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Install directly from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Daseanle/dsh-obsidian-bridge

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Configure via cordis.patch.yml：dsh web
```

**Option B: From npm (when published)**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-obsidian-bridge
dsh web
```

**Option C: From local clone**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Daseanle/dsh-obsidian-bridge.git
cd dsh-obsidian-bridge && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-obsidian-bridge
dsh web
```

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Configuration：Create or edit `cordis.patch.yml` in your DSH config directory:

```yaml
- id: dsh-obsidian-bridge
  config:
    vaultPath: /path/to/your/vault
    autoContext: false        # auto-inject vault context before each model step

Or use environment variables (legacy, used as fallback when config values are not provided):

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Configuration：```bash
export OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH="/path/to/your/vault"
export DSH_OBSIDIAN_AUTO_CONTEXT=true   # optional
export DSH_OBSIDIAN_AUTO_CAPTURE=true   # optional
export DSH_SESSION_ID="my-session"      # optional

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Config Schema (zod)：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `vaultPath` | string | `""` | Absolute path to your Obsidian Vault |
| `autoContext` | boolean | `false` | Auto-inject vault context before each model step |
| `autoCapture` | boolean | `false` | Auto-capture non-Obsidian tool results as drafts |
| `draftFolder` | string | `"dsh-drafts"` | Folder name for draft notes |
| `sessionId` | string | `""` | Session ID for draft frontmatter and session linking |
dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Config Schema (zod)：Config is validated via zod Standard Schema V1. Values can be provided through `cordis.patch.yml` or environment variables (as fallback).

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · Environment Variables：| Variable | Fallback For | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH` | `vaultPath` | — |
| `DSH_OBSIDIAN_AUTO_CONTEXT` | `autoContext` | `false` |
| `DSH_OBSIDIAN_AUTO_CAPTURE` | `autoCapture` | `false` |
| `DSH_SESSION_ID` | `sessionId` | `""` |
dsh-obsidian-bridge README · SQLite FTS5 Index：The plugin creates a `.dsh/index.db` SQLite database inside your vault directory:

dsh-obsidian-bridge README · SQLite FTS5 Index：- **FTS5 virtual table** with `unicode61` tokenizer
- **UNINDEXED columns** for metadata (path, frontmatter, mtime, etc.)
- **BM25 relevance ranking** for search results
- **Incremental sync**: only re-reads notes whose `mtime` changed
- **Throttled sync**: skips re-sync within 2s of last sync (unless invalidated)
- **Chinese support**: CJK characters are split for unicode61 tokenization
- **WAL mode** with 16MB cache for performance
